findings.source: Simply Wall St: BESI Second-Quarter Results Are Out And Analysts Have Published New Forecasts
findings.excerpt: BE Semiconductor Industries' 22 analysts are now forecasting revenues of €987.8m in 2026. This would be a huge 35% improvement in revenue compared to the last 12 months. Statutory earnings per share are predicted to bounce 64% to €4.23. Yet prior to the latest earnings, the analysts had been anticipated revenues of €954.8m and earnings per share (EPS) of €4.04 in 2026.

findings.claim: Investing.com 共識 Buy，23 位分析師，平均目標價約 €296.57，區間 €173–€401
Q2-26 財報給 Q3-26 營收季增 10–15%、毛利率 63–65%、營業費用持平至 +5%
findings.excerpt: Q3-26 revenue is expected to increase 10-15% sequentially from Q2-26, driven by continued AI and mainstream market demand. Gross margin is projected to be 63-65% in Q3-26, slightly lower due to a less favorable product mix.

findings.claim: 2026 年 6 月 Oddo BHF 目標價由 €375 升至 €400；公司上調長期目標（營業利益率 45–55%、營收 €1.7–2.2bn），市場反應有限
findings.source: Boursorama: Besi en hausse limitée après un relèvement d'objectifs sans grande surprise
findings.excerpt: Besi a relevé ses objectifs financiers à long terme, tablant désormais sur une marge opérationnelle comprise entre 45% et 55%, pour un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 1,7 et 2,2 MdsEUR, à comparer à des fourchettes cibles de respectivement 40% à 55% et de 1,5 à 1,9 MdEUR il y a un an.
